summary: Tested Admin WhatsApp Config UI refactor with 4 sections: Webhook & Diagnostics, Platform Credentials, Client Tenant Defaults, System Template Approval Status. All 8 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: Both 'Save Platform Credentials' and 'Save Tenant Credentials' buttons call the same save() handler which sends ALL fields (app_id, config_id, waba_id, phone_number_id, webhook_verify_token) in one PUT. This means clicking either save button saves everything — not truly separated. Minor UX concern if admin intends to update only platform or only tenant fields independently.
No data-testid on the template-status-card itself (uses 'template-status-card' not in spec list, spec says 'template-status-table' — present and correct).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 sections visible, webhook test button returns HTTP 200, all 4 templates show UNKNOWN status (expected in test env with no WABA/token), refresh and publish buttons visible

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin WhatsApp Config page fully tested at /admin/whatsapp-config. 4 sections: (1) Webhook & Diagnostics card with test button working — returns HTTP 200 with challenge echo. (2) Platform Credentials card with meta-app-id, meta-app-secret, meta-config-id, meta-verify-token + save button. (3) Client Tenant Defaults with meta-waba-id, meta-phone-id, meta-system-token + save button. (4) Template Status Table with all 4 templates showing UNKNOWN (no WABA configured). GET /api/admin/whatsapp-templates-status returns 200 with 4-item array, 401 without auth. Webhook GET endpoint returns challenge echo at /api/meta-whatsapp/webhook.
